data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2016 the syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding were GBP 36.521m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle shows a net prior-year strengthening of approximately GBP 23.16m (c.63% of opening gross claims reserves), driven predominantly by adverse development in older years (notably 2014 and 2013) and concentrated in liability exposures. The report references adverse results emanating from the Irish Republic and early losses that disproportionately affected a small premium base as contributing factors.
raw_causal_phrases: a number of early losses had a disproportionate impact on a small premium base
This is despite action being taken to correct adverse results emanating from the Irish Republic due to the difficult legal environment

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (PYD) calculated from the published GROSS claims development triangle (page 29) by excluding the two most recent underwriting years (2016, 2015) and summing changes for 2013 and 2014. The report provides net analyses by line of business; gross PYD by LOB is not provided, so LOB amounts are left null. There is a reinsurance-to-close activity referenced elsewhere which can distort some reserve tables, but the triangle used appears to present gross incurred estimates for individual underwriting years. Confidence flagged accordingly.
